info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-Delete Creditcard Applications Decline-v1-spec
info.description: The Credit Card Applications Decline Management API enables financial institutions to efficiently manage declined credit card applications. This endpoint allows users to remove specific declined applications from the system, ensuring that application data is up-to-date and accurate. Typical consumers of this API include backend systems and administrative dashboards that handle application processing and reporting. By leveraging this API, organizations can streamline their application review processes and maintain clean application records.

delete.description: This endpoint allows a user to decline an application request, indicating that the application will not be processed further. Ensure that the appropriate application ID is specified when making this request.
